title: hive-pool import-legacy: request body
description: Reads one legacy Markdown backlog and either reports what it holds (dry_run true, nothing written) or imports it into this Pool with an explicit identity migration. The file is read and never written. The Pool refuses a home inside a repository before it reads anything, so an import can never write into a project's code root. See spec/pool.md, Legacy import and export.

path.description: The legacy backlog's physical path. It is recorded in the migration and never leaves the home.

zone.description: The zone the file's calendar dates are read in.

expected_digest.description: Refuse with conflict if the file's digest differs: the caller imports what it inspected.
